svg.title: Agreement and accuracy are separate tests
svg.desc: In 24 tested cases HIP and Mojo produced identical output bytes. Against an independent mathematical reference Float64 passed and Float32 failed. This does not validate physical reality or qualify performance.

g.text: Two programs can agree and still miss the target.
Mojo / AMD stencil qualification • S02-I • 20 August 2026
Do both programs give the same answer?
Does that answer meet the reference limits?
Use qualified Float64. Investigate lower precision separately.
Overall S02-I: FAIL • Findings apply to the tested stencil and environment.
Neither test proves physical feasibility. This campaign did not qualify speed.
